sources.title: Ling 3.0 Flash API & Playground | Novita AI
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash is a 124B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, with approximately 5.1B parameters activated per token. The model is designed with token efficiency and production-scale agentic inference as key priorities, enabling developers to complete more useful work within constrained token, latency, and serving-cost budgets.
